series.summary: Rick shoots Jerry's beloved brother Steve at breakfast, exposing him as a memory-implanting alien parasite, but an even stranger guest has already infiltrated.

cuts.voiceover_text: The family is thrilled when beloved Uncle Steve surprises them with tickets to Paris. Jerry is charmed, but someone at this table does not belong.
Rick confronts Jerry about who Steve really is. When Jerry defends him, Rick shoots Steve dead. Shockingly, the corpse morphs into a grotesque alien parasite.
Rick reveals these telepathic monsters conquer planets by implanting fake loving memories into human brains. Every warm memory of Uncle Steve was a lie.
Rick warns them to watch for wacky strangers. Suddenly, Mr. Poopybutthole appears at the table, and Rick trusts him completely. Is Rick already infected?
